A standalone verifier checks 393 independent faces and exact F2 boundary ranks 15,65,95,16; rank lower bounds and consecutive-boundary identities force identical rational ranks and H3 dimension nine. No integral lattice classification or infinite claim is inferred.

value.rationale: A canonical distance-transitive triangle-free folded cube with rank-nine spherical homology has an unexpectedly structured full symmetry module: one sign-twisted standard component and one transitive monomial component supported on five nontrivial translation characters. The dimension-four translation-fixed and dimension-zero full-fixed contrast captures structure not obtainable from the known Euler number and wedge-of-spheres classification. This is a complete exact natural equivariant invariant, not an arbitrary subgraph slice or a routine table recomputation.
